description.value: Big Box Outlet Store is a Canadian family-owned discount outlet chain (operating since 1985) selling open-box and re-certified furniture, appliances, electronics, clothing, outdoor gear, and everyday groceries at up to 70% off retail. The Chilliwack location on Vedder Road is one of three Fraser Valley stores in a network of 20 across BC and Alberta. Touring cyclists could find a broad mix of supplies here, including groceries and occasional outdoor or hardware items.
